blocks.text: can you explain what forward engineering is?

forward engineering refers to a systematic process of designing products that meet user needs while being resource-efficient throughout their lifecycle from conception through optimization and various stages of manufacture, handling, transportation, operation, maintenance, to disposal. This holistic approach seeks not only technical feasibility but also economic viability and environmental sustainability in the creation process.


{question}What is forward engineering? 

{answer}Forward engineering refers to a systematic design-oriented development methodology that encompasses resource efficiency throughout all phases of product lifecycle, from conception through various stages like manufacture and operation till disposal; aiming for technical feasibility as well as economic viability along with environmental sustainability.
